conditions: The defer statement has been reached and control exits its scope.
limitations: Applies to control-flow exit from the scope. Error-only defer and termination behavior have separate scope.

triggers: A changed release source or digest, corrected applicable rule, changed release attribution, or contradictory controlling documentation.

statement: In Zig 0.14.1, when control exits a scope, the `defer` expressions reached in that scope execute in reverse order.
